entries.title: See why a purchase order cannot be previewed
entries.description: Empty purchase orders now disable preview, with clearer explanations when preview is unavailable.

entries.title: Read dates and amounts more easily
entries.description: Dates now use consistent day-first formats, and relative times use plain language such as “5 days ago”. Monetary amounts default to rand unless another currency is specified.

entries.title: Tap recent timestamps for the exact time
entries.description: Recent timestamps use readable labels such as “Today at 14:05” or “3 days ago”. Tap these labels to see the exact date and time.
